entries.title: Genesis 24:1
segments: Was old; aged one hundred and forty years.

entries.title: Genesis 24:2
segments: Eldest servant; supposed to by Eliezer.
Under my thigh; a form of making solemn engagements.

entries.title: Genesis 24:3
segments: Make thee swear; put thee under oath, or make thee enter into a sacred engagement.

entries.title: Genesis 24:4
segments:
My country, Mesopotamia. 
 
  Kindred; relatives. 
 
A wise parent will take a deep interest in the marriage of his children, as affecting not only their usefulness and happiness, but that of their posterityl

entries.title: Genesis 24:7
segments: Send his angel; to make thy way prosperous.

entries.title: Genesis 24:10
segments: The city of Nahor; Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 24:11
segments: Kneel down; the posture in which camels take their rest.

entries.title: Genesis 24:12
segments:
Send me good speed; prosper me in my undertaking. 
 
Those who in all their ways acknowledge God and seek his blessing, may expect that he will make plain before them the path of duty, and enable them successfully and gratefully to walk in it.

entries.title: Genesis 24:14
segments: Industry, kindness, economy, and beneficence are virtues which every prudent man will seek in a wife, as upon these the happiness, respectability, and usefulness of families very much depend.

entries.title: Genesis 24:15
segments: Rebekah;

entries.title: Genesis 24:21
segments:
Wondering at her; to see how exactly his prayer was answered. 
 
  To wit; to know, form the indications of Providence. 
 
Believing prayer is often so speedily and abundantly answered as to astonish those who offer it, and lead them in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, to make known their requests unto God.

entries.title: Genesis 24:27
segments: All the kindness which we receive from men, and all our success in business, we should acknowledge as coming from God, and be excited by it to new fidelity in learning and doing his will.

entries.title: Genesis 24:32
segments: He ungirded; that is, Laban.

entries.title: Genesis 24:33
segments: A faithful man will regard his appropriate business as more important than his personal gratification, and will endeavor so to conduct it as shall be most likely to insure success.  For this purpose, while he will habitually pray for the divine blessing, he will use all suitable means, that his prayers may be answered.

entries.title: Genesis 24:45
segments: Speaking in my heart; offering silent prayer.

entries.title: Genesis 24:48
segments:
Brother's daughter; she was the daughter of Abraham's nephew. 
 
When we have learned, by experience, the right way to secure the divine guidance and blessing, and God has given us success, it is proper to make known this way to others, that they may be induced to do likewise.

entries.title: Genesis 24:49
segments: Deal kindly; in permitting Rebekah to become Isaac's wife.

entries.title: Genesis 24:52
segments:
He worshipped the Lord; as the author of his success. 
 
New favors will draw forth from a grateful heart new thanksgivings, till the habit become fixed of giving thanks always, for all things, unto God.

entries.title: Genesis 24:58
segments: It is happy, when one's inclinations and the indications of Providence coincide; and a readiness promptly to do right, and make any sacrifices which duty requires, is a good preparation to be blessed, and to become a blessing.

entries.title: Genesis 24:59
segments: Her nurse; Deborah.

entries.title: Genesis 24:60
segments: Possess the gate; be victorious over their enemies.

South country; the country south of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 24:63
segments: Stated and devout meditation upon the character, works, and ways of God, communion with him, and commitment of our interests to his care, are often followed by his special favors.

entries.title: Genesis 24:65
segments: Covered herself; according to the custom in that country.

entries.title: Genesis 24:67
segments: Sarah's tent; which was hers when living, she having been dead about three years.
